active_vm_count.aggregation: distinct observed VM IDs per timestamp

aggregate_cpu_utilization.aggregation: unweighted mean of VM avg_cpu per timestamp, percent
aggregate_cpu_utilization.forecast_mode: fixed origin; last 12 observed values averaged once for all 24 leads

selection.refit: use first 110 observations only; no fitting on holdout labels
selection.missing_data: fail on missing, invalid, duplicate, or incomplete observations

headroom_policy.kind: empirical one-sided aggregate CPU planning allowance
headroom_policy.residual_definition: actual minus point forecast, development validation only
headroom_policy.breach_rule: observed aggregate CPU > its fixed-origin planning ceiling
headroom_policy.review_rule: alert once at the second consecutive breach; clear the run on recovery
headroom_policy.budget_rule: if an independently established budget B exists, review capacity before max(ceiling) >= B
headroom_policy.hardware_capacity_conversion: unavailable; mean utilization is not total consumed cores
